title: Palindrome Roll Numbers

examples.explanation: 21CS1SC12 reads the same backwards. So does abcBA once you ignore case, and so does any single character. CSE2025 doesn't.

hints: Compare the first character with the last, the second with the second-to-last, and so on. You can stop as soon as one pair differs.
Convert both characters to lower case before comparing them. Digits are unchanged by that.
